title: Prepare and check model choices
responsibility: Converts listed provider models for display and checks the requested model and effort.

inputs.name: providerModels.models
inputs.description: The provider’s models with identifiers, display names, hidden flags, effort choices, default effort and default-model flag.

inputs.name: validateModel.models
inputs.description: The model choices available for selection.

inputs.name: validateModel.effort
inputs.description: The optional effort to check. Null or an empty string skips effort validation.

outputs.name: providerModels
outputs.description: Visible models in input order, with identifiers and effort values retained and hidden models removed.

outputs.name: validateModel
outputs.description: No return value when the model exists and any nonempty requested effort is supported. No default model or effort is substituted.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws when the requested model is absent or its requested effort is unsupported.
